about: In communion with the whole Church, the prayer honors the memory of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Saint Joseph, the Apostles, and the martyrs. After naming the saints, it asks God to surround the faithful with His protection through their merits and prayers.

seg.tr: In communion, we venerate the memory above all of the glorious Mary, ever Virgin, Mother of our God and Lord Jesus Christ:
and also blessed Joseph, Spouse of that same Virgin,
and of Your blessed Apostles and Martyrs: Peter and Paul, Andrew, James, John, Thomas, James, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Simon, and Thaddeus;

ex.w033: The list names twelve Apostles, including Paul rather than Matthias.
ex.w038: His place in the list distinguishes him from “Iacóbi” (w035).

seg.tr: Linus, Cletus, Clement, Sixtus, Cornelius, Cyprian, Lawrence, Chrysogonus, John and Paul, Cosmas and Damian;

ex.w045: Linus begins the second group of twelve names in this prayer.

seg.tr: and of all Your Saints; through their merits and prayers, grant that we may be guarded in all things by Your protecting help.
Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
